central.name: Central
central.description:
Have a cup of joe, bagels, pastries and salads at this contemporary café with counter service and self check-out kiosk. Customized cake orders must be placed at least three working days in advance.

No wet attire allowed in the cafe.

the-2nd-floor.name: The 2nd Floor
the-2nd-floor.description:
Amidst the plethora of fusion restaurants in Singapore, none is as exquisite as the award-winning, The 2nd Floor. The logo suggests its East and West origin. The two bold strokes represent the Chinese character for 2 – "er". The Eastern menu is in perfect harmony with authentic Asian flavors and unique contemporary presentations.

The Western menu is an interpretation of the Modern American Steakhouse and combines bistro ambiance with fine dining fare. The restaurant attained the Excellent Dining Venue award at the Global Gourmet 2020 Chef par Excellence Culinary Competition.

tradewinds.name: Tradewinds
tradewinds.description:
Tradewinds takes your tastebuds around the world with its international menu offering. The menu selection features nuances of flavors from America to Singapore.

This restaurant takes its name from the prevailing surface winds – also known as trade winds – that blow predominantly from the northeast in the Northern Hemisphere and from the southeast in the Southern Hemisphere.

For centuries, trade winds have facilitated ships to cross the world's oceans, establishing trade routes across the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.

Tradewinds brings the world's flavors to The American Club table.

union-bar.name: Union Bar
union-bar.description:
Nothing feels like a Friday night than bar bites and a cold beer. Grab a bite and a drink after work, and watch the latest football or basketball game on TV, only at the Union Bar.

Happy Hours are even happier now that you can enjoy 20% off house pour and beer starting an hour earlier, from 4:00 PM, until 8:00 PM, daily!

Please be informed that Union Bar does not take any reservations. Strictly walk-ins only.

extraSections.title: Wine Corkage Policy
extraSections.content:
Members and Guests are welcome to bring their own wine with a standard corkage of $20. You can also enjoy 1-for-1 corkage or complimentary corkage with the purchase of one of our bottles.

Please note that Union Bar operates on a walk-in basis only, and reservations are not accepted. Members and Guests must be above 18 years old to order alcoholic beverages.

extraSections.title: Age Policy
extraSections.content:
Members and Guests above 18 years of age are welcome.

Members and Guests ordering alcoholic beverages are required to present a valid photo ID. The following IDs are recognized: Club membership card, passport, Singapore NRIC, driver's license and government issued IDs only.

the-gourmet-pantry.name: The Gourmet Pantry
the-gourmet-pantry.description:
The Gourmet Pantry brings together an excellent selection of wines, featuring more than 100 American wine labels alongside over 300 international labels, thoughtfully curated for every occasion – from easy-drinking table wines to premium selections and celebratory bubblies.

Complementing the wine collection is a distinctive range of homeware and table settings, making it a convenient, one-stop destination for both everyday needs and special moments.
